messages:
adele: heads up — acme's POC started getting intermittent 429s from our hosted endpoint during their CI runs last night. dashboard shows they still have token balance, but their tests hit failures around the same time. any quick guesses? :confused:

samir: can you paste the route + sample request ID? also did the errors look like per-route throttles (429 with rate-limit header) or generic 429s?

adele: here are examples from their logs (redacted):
```
request_id=01F3Z4XJ; route=acme-demo-v1; status=429; hdr_retry_after=0; reason=rate_limit; tokens_charged=312
request_id=01F3Z5AA; route=acme-demo-v1; status=200; tokens_charged=12
request_id=01F3Z6BB; route=acme-demo-v1; status=429; hdr_retry_after=0; reason=burst_window_exceeded; tokens_charged=0
```

maya: they run a parallel test matrix in CI that spins up ~40 concurrent workers hitting the same route with long prompts. could be burst shaping vs sustained cap mismatch. they said dashboard per-tenant quota looked fine.

samir: ok that points to per-route token-bucket / sliding window enforcement. our per-tenant counters are one thing; per-route buckets can fill quickly if many concurrencies fire at once. can we get the exact timestamps? that’ll let me check the burst window logs.

adele: timestamps (UTC): 2026-03-20T21:42:11Z, 2026-03-20T21:42:12Z, 2026-03-20T21:42:13Z — essentially back-to-back.

chris: quick note from infra — we recently optimized KV cache eviction which changed request batching timing for short requests; could increase token accounting spikes for identical concurrency bursts. not sure it's root cause but relevant.

samir: pulled the quota backend logs for that tenant & route. snippet: 
```
[21:42:11] quota_check tenant=acme cid=acme-123 route=acme-demo-v1 window=60s tokens_in_window=298 limit=300 allow=false reason=burst_window_exceeded
[21:42:12] quota_adjust tenant=acme route=acme-demo-v1 tokens=12 total=310
[21:42:13] quota_check tenant=acme route=acme-demo-v1 window=60s tokens_in_window=310 limit=300 allow=false reason=hard_limit
```

samir: you can see the token window crossed the limit because their CI sent a 300+ token request pattern in a ~1s span. dashboard per-tenant view aggregates differently and smooths some transient bursts; per-route enforcement is stricter.

adele: @maya can we ask the customer to stagger CI jobs or add jitter? they're running thousands of tests per day and need deterministic results.

maya: yes, i'll recommend jitter + reduce concurrency to 10 workers for the POC. also asking if they can queue high-token tests to off-peak hours.

adele: they also asked why the retry-after header is 0 in some 429s — looks like immediate deny instead of telling clients when to retry.

samir: that 0 means we don't have a predictable bucket refill point for that exact burst (sliding windows vs fixed window), so we return a quick 429. we should return a small backoff header at minimum. i'll open a follow-up ticket to ensure we emit an approximate retry-after in burst cases.

chris: temporary mitigation: we can do a one-off soft bump for their demo route on Dedicated-like limits for next 48h while they adjust tests. need approval from finance for any quota bump beyond trial credit.

maya: acme agreed to the stagger and also asked for documentation so their test infra can implement exponential backoff for 429s. can we send a short blurb they can paste?

samir: suggested snippet to handle 429s in their test harness:
```
for i in 1..3:
  resp = curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"route":"acme-demo-v1","input":"..."}'
  if resp.status == 200: break
  if resp.status == 429:
    sleep rand(200..800)/1000.0 * (2 ** i)  # jittered exponential backoff
```

adele: i'll coordinate the temporary bump and confirm billing check. thanks team. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T08:12:00Z - rollout: quota-metrics-relabel v2 - success

samir: follow-up actions: 1) add retry-after heuristic for burst_window_exceeded (SRE ticket), 2) docs blurb for handling 429s (devex), 3) short-term route bump for acme (ops -> confirm with finance). tagging chris for ops work.

chris: noted — will prepare the ops doc and queue the bump pending finance ok.

maya: acme appreciates the quick turnaround. they want a short postmortem after the POC to avoid this at scale. i'll schedule. :calendar:
